The process

How we make a tech company visible in search and AI answers

Audit, structure, technical work and content are handled by the team that designs and builds the website. You follow every step in the client portal, with the data, the decisions and the pages in one place.

Step 01 02 03 04 05 / 05

  1. Step 01

    Audit

    We crawl the site, read Search Console and Core Web Vitals, and ask AI assistants what they say about you. Every issue is ranked by impact.

    Crawl Search Console

  2. Step 02

    Search and question map

    The searches and questions that lead to your product, grouped by intent, each one assigned to a single page.

    Keywords Intents

  3. Step 03

    Technical foundations

    Crawlable structure, redirects, speed, JSON-LD, llms.txt and AI crawler access, fixed in the site itself.

    Structure Schema

  4. Step 04

    Pages and articles

    Service pages and articles that answer one question each, written with your team's expertise and structured to be quoted.

    Content GEO

  5. Step 05

    Monthly follow-up

    Clicks, rankings and AI answers checked every month, new articles published, and the plan adjusted to what the data says.

    Reporting Content

What you get
